source_summary: Horizontal Chinese landscape with pale ink-and-color mountains, misty water, rocky shores, sparse autumn trees, pavilions, a tall pine, and tiny scholar figures. Calligraphy, seals, borders, and paper texture are excluded.

motifs.name: left_misty_mountain_chain
motifs.description: Isolate the distant left mountain range: pale blue-gray background peaks and low ochre-green foothills running behind the water, with soft mist gaps and scattered dark texture dots along ridge lines.
must_preserve: faint ochre and green hillside washes
small dark cun and dot texture accents

motifs.name: central_craggy_ridge
motifs.description: Isolate the central rocky mountain ridge above the lake, including layered ochre slopes, pale green wash, angular peak outlines, and clustered black texture marks, but exclude calligraphy above and lower pavilions below.
must_preserve: black vertical texture dashes on cliff faces

motifs.name: left_foreground_shore_trees
motifs.description: Isolate the lower-left riverbank with bare deciduous trees, small shrubs, sloping earth bank, and sparse rock dots at the water edge.
must_preserve: dark ink trunks and exposed roots
small black rock and shrub dots

motifs.name: central_lake_mist_surface
motifs.description: Isolate the open lake and mist band in the center-left, including faint horizontal water strokes, pale reed patches, and low shoreline washes without nearby buildings.
must_preserve: very light horizontal ink and ochre water lines

motifs.name: lower_center_pavilion_promontory
motifs.description: Isolate the small pavilion and adjacent waterside promontory near the lower center, with its sloped tiled roof, posts, surrounding bare trees, low hut roof, and rocky mound.
must_preserve: thin ruled roof geometry and eaves
bare tree saplings beside the buildings
rocky promontory with ochre-green texture strokes

motifs.name: central_rocky_hill_tree_grove
motifs.description: Isolate the large central hillside and tree grove rising behind the path: rounded rocky slope, leafless and lightly colored trees, shrubs, and the dark ledge near the top.
must_preserve: muted red and blue-green foliage touches

motifs.name: right_pavilion_flowering_grove
motifs.description: Isolate the right-side pavilion compound and nearby flowering trees at the foot of the hill, including two stacked roof structures, pink foliage, path edge, and tiny scholar figures just to the left.
must_preserve: precise tiled roof lines and upturned eaves
tiny dark-robed scholar figures and path linework

motifs.name: right_tall_pine_and_rear_hills
motifs.description: Isolate the tall twisting pine on the right with its needle clusters, neighboring bare trees, and the pale rear hillside behind it, avoiding nearby seals and calligraphy.
must_preserve: blue-green needle clusters in layered tufts
fine bare tree branches around the pine
dotted black rock texture along ridge

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
